Subject: Private deployment architecture review — VPC & air-gapped constraints

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the initial outreach last week — we're ready to lock in a technical deep-dive to cover private deployment requirements (VPC peering, on‑prem air‑gapped constraints, and procurement pre-reads). Our security and infra leads (Tom Alvarez and I) need to validate network/topology and the evidence we will present in the vendor questionnaire.

High level ask: 60–75 minute session to walk architecture, required ports, KMS options, and the offline airgap process. Helpful if you can include a short runbook and a network template ahead of time.

Availability windows next week (PT):
- Tue 9/9: 08:30–11:30 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 9/10: 09:00–12:00

Attendees from our side: Tom (network lead), myself (security), and one infrastructure engineer — we may add procurement for a short part.

Attached: helix-vpc-requirements.xlsx (brief).

Can you propose 2 possible slots and an agenda? Also let us know if any constrained pieces require a separate ops-only call.

Best,
Sienna Miller
Director, Infrastructure Security
Helix Pharma

Hi Sienna — thanks for the note and the attachment. We can cover everything you listed. Proposed options (PT):

Option A — Thu 9/11 09:00–10:15 PT (60–75m)
Option B — Fri 9/12 15:00–16:15 PT (60–75m)

Proposed agenda (short):
- 0–10m: introductions & success criteria (your must-haves)
- 10–30m: VPC/networking: peering, NAT, egress controls, firewall rules
- 30–50m: air-gapped/on‑prem flow: image ingestion, KMS integration, offline patching
- 50–65m: evidence & compliance: audit logs, retention, SOC-related artifacts
- 65–75m: open questions & next steps / RACI

Attendees from Redwood: Diego Fernandez (deploy runtime lead), Aditya Rao (solutions engineer, will demo topology diagram), Mina Haddad (security/compliance SME). I attached our private deployment checklist and a network topology template for your team to review before the call.

Pre-reads: I put a short folder in Drive (link below) with the checklist and a sample network diagram — if you can drop any additional constraints there, we will tailor the demo.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHelixPreRead
Attachments: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf, network-topology-template.drawio

Let me know which option you prefer and whether you want us to include a short procurement-focused segment at the end. If neither slot works, we can look at next week as well.

—Marissa
